assumptions: One durable job, two execution generations and a clock bounded to six ticks. The same app generation may survive job recovery.
Job, lease and dependent-resource locks serialize a committed write; lease time is rechecked after the resource lock. No TypeScript or SQL isolation refinement is proved.
Provider dispatch and completion remain external. A lease timeout or cancellation does not prove remote quiescence; an explicit witness retains overlapping old and new provider calls.
No fairness, eventual completion, provider-side fencing, or cross-job routing ownership is proved.
bounds.progress: No temporal or fairness claim. Repeated failure and stuttering remain permitted.
